AddSceneItemRequest.description: Request to add a source to a scene. Missing values are chosen by the server (1240/680, 600 × 338, radius 12, contain for screens).

AllocateSlotRequest.description: Allocates a new slot on the device (another screen, or the optional laptop camera).

id.description: Asset id, e.g. `ast_…`; also the source reference.

name.description: Display name (from the file name, editable).

contentUrl.description: Relative URL of the content. The output appends its key as `?k=`.

AssetKind.description: Kind of an uploaded media asset.

serverMs.description: Time the server needed to receive the body.

BandwidthTestResultDto.description: Result of the upload part of the technical check.

BorderDto.description: Border drawn inside the item rectangle.

BroadcastState.description: Broadcast state of a production. Standby and Ended show a slate on the output.

cloneFromSceneId.description: Copy items, layout mode and background from this scene.

CropDto.description: Crop per side as a fraction (0–0.45) of the source picture. Opposite sides sum to less than 0.9.

DeviceCommandKind.description: Remote command the Regie sends to a device.

DeviceCommandRequest.description: Sends a remote command to a device.

DeviceConnection.description: Live connection state of a device as seen by the server.

DeviceCredentialsDto.description: Credentials of a paired device. The secret is shown exactly to the device and stored only as a hash.

id.description: Device id, e.g. `dev_…`; equals the LiveKit participant identity.

name.description: Display name, editable in the Regie.

platform.description: Short platform text reported by the sender, e.g. «iPhone · Safari».

connectionSince.description: Time of the last connection change.

DeviceDto.description: A paired device (station) as shown in the Regie.

sessionId.description: Random id of this browser tab; a newer session replaces an older one.

DeviceHelloDto.description: First message of a device after connecting to the device hub.

rttMs.description: Round trip time measured by the sender.

oneOf.description: Result of the last technical check, if any.

DeviceReportDto.description: Periodic report of a device (about every two seconds).

DeviceSelfDto.description: What a device learns about itself (sender app).

DeviceSlotDto.description: A slot that belongs to a device, with its slot code.

batteryPct.description: Battery level 0–100 where the browser exposes it.

network.description: Network type, e.g. «wifi» or «4g», where available.

rttMs.description: Round trip time to the server.

DeviceTelemetryDto.description: Telemetry of a device, reported about every two seconds.

DeviceTelemetryMessage.description: Telemetry push to the Regie; not revisioned.

endedAt.description: Recovery time; null while the outage lasts.

IncidentDto.description: An incident in the message strip. Recovered incidents stay until someone acknowledges them («Gesehen»).

IncidentKind.description: Kind of an incident in the message strip.

url.description: Absolute URL with the secret token; only visible to the Regie.

InviteDto.description: A one-time invite (QR code for phones, link for laptops). Valid once for 30 minutes.

ItemFit.description: How a source is fitted into its item rectangle.

url.description: WebSocket URL of LiveKit (same origin, proxied by Caddy).

expiresAt.description: Token expiry; LiveKit refreshes it for running connections.

LiveKitTokenDto.description: LiveKit connection data for a client. The token carries exactly the rights of the role.

LogEntryDto.description: A human-readable entry for «Letzte Ereignisse» (backed by the audit log).

holdMs.description: How long the last frame stays sharp (0…600000 ms); null keeps it forever. Afterwards the frame is blurred and darkened with «Bild kommt gleich zurück», or the fallback source is shown.

fallbackSource.description: Optional replacement source reference (e.g. a pause slate image).

LostBehaviorDto.description: Fallback when the source of an item fails.

events.description: Events after the requested revision, oldest first; null when a snapshot is returned.

oneOf.description: Full output state; null when IReadOnlyList<ProductionEvent>? OutputChangesDto.Events is returned.

OutputChangesDto.description:
Output variant of ProductionChangesDto (hub `SubscribeOutput` and `GET /api/output/{slug}/changes`):
changes the output must not see – devices, pairing, invites, incidents, log, output status and health-only source
changes – appear as RevisionOnlyEvent with the same revision.

rendering.description: The page renders the program (false while connecting).

latencyMs.description: Estimated receive latency (RTT/2 plus jitter buffer delay).

OutputReport.description: Status report of an output page, sent about every two seconds.

url.description: Absolute output URL including the secret key.

keyCreatedAt.description: When the current key was created.

allowedIps.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to open the output; empty allows every address.

frameAncestors.description: Domains allowed to embed the output (from configuration, read-only).

revision.description: Same revision counter as the Regie snapshot.

scenes.description: All scenes (the output preloads their sources).

OutputSnapshot.description: Production state for the output page. Contains no device, pairing or incident data.

OutputState.description: Connection state of the output consumer (proxy).

addresses.description: Remote IP addresses of the output pages.

latencyMs.description: Estimated receive latency reported by the output page.

fps.description: Rendered frames per second of the program.

OutputStatusDto.description: Live state of the output consumer (chip «Output an Proxy» in the header).

PairingRequestCreatedDto.description: Answer to a knock: the requester keeps the poll token secret and polls with it.

name.description: Device name typed on the laptop.

checkCode.description: Four digit check code, shown as «47 12» on both screens.

PairingRequestDto.description: A pending /join request as shown to the Regie (knock card).

PairingRequestStatus.description: Status of an anonymous pairing request from /join.

PairingRequestStatusDto.description: Poll result for a knock. Credentials are present once the Regie approved.

events.description: Events after the requested revision, oldest first; null when a snapshot is returned.

oneOf.description: Full state; null when IReadOnlyList<ProductionEvent>? ProductionChangesDto.Events is returned.

ProductionChangesDto.description:
Answer to a (re)subscribe or `GET …/changes?since=`: either the missed events (delta) or a full snapshot when the
server no longer holds all events since the requested revision.

tenantId.description: Tenant id; only `opten` for now (multi-tenancy is prepared, not active).

name.description: Display name shown in the header.

slug.description: URL slug of the output page (`/o/{slug}`).

isActive.description: The active production is the one /join pairs into.

liveSince.description: Start of the current broadcast (LIVE runtime in the header).

programSceneId.description: Scene on air. Null only when the production has no scenes.

previewSceneId.description: Scene in the preview (Studio-Modus). Null when no operator uses Studio-Modus.

oneOf.description: Transition of the last program switch.

lastSwitchAt.description: Server time of the last program switch.

ProductionDto.description: Production (OBS: scene collection): one event with its own devices, scenes and output.

ProductionEvent.description:
A revisioned change of the production state, pushed over SignalR (method string HubMethods.Event).
Clients apply an event only when its revision is exactly one above their own; a larger gap triggers a resync
(new snapshot), a smaller revision is ignored.

ProductionEventAssetUpsertedEvent.description: An asset was uploaded or renamed.

ProductionEventDeviceUpsertedEvent.description: A device was paired or changed (name, state, connection, tech check).

ProductionEventIncidentRemovedEvent.description: An incident was acknowledged or superseded.

ProductionEventIncidentUpsertedEvent.description: An incident started, changed or recovered.

ProductionEventInviteRemovedEvent.description: An invite was used, revoked or expired.

ProductionEventPairingRequestRemovedEven.description: A knock was approved, denied or expired.

ProductionEventProductionChangedEvent.description: Production settings or broadcast state changed (not a program switch).

previousProgramSceneId.description: Program scene before the switch (fade source).

transition.description: Transition to play; a cut when only the preview changed.

ProductionEventProgramSwitchedEvent.description: Program and/or preview changed. Renderers play TransitionDto ProgramSwitchedEvent.Transition when the program changed.

ProductionEventRevisionOnlyEvent.description: Placeholder that only advances the revision; sent to clients that must not see the actual change (output page).

ProductionEventScenesReorderedEvent.description: The scene order changed; IReadOnlyList<string> ScenesReorderedEvent.SceneIds lists every scene in the new order.

ProductionEventSceneUpsertedEvent.description: A scene was created or changed.

ProductionEventSourceRemovedEvent.description: A source was removed (slot released, device or asset deleted).

ProductionEventSourceUpsertedEvent.description: A source was created or its health or label changed.

revision.description: Monotonic revision; every ProductionEvent carries the next one.

serverTime.description: Server clock, used to correct client timers.

incidents.description: Open and recovered, not yet acknowledged incidents.

ProductionSnapshot.description: Complete production state for the Regie. Sent on subscribe and after a resync.

clientId.description: Random id the browser generated before redeeming; repeating the call with the same id within five minutes returns the same device (lost responses).

name.description: Optional device name; defaults to a generated one.

RedeemInviteRequest.description: Redeems a QR code or invite link.

ReorderScenesRequest.description: New order of all scenes; must contain every scene id exactly once.

items.description: Complete new item list, back to front.

oneOf.description: Optional new layout mode (the Auto-Grid template sets SceneLayoutMode.AutoGrid).

ReplaceSceneItemsRequest.description: Replaces all items of a scene (templates, undo/redo, reordering).

RtcState.description: Media connection state reported by the sender.

assetId.description: Optional image asset, drawn with cover fit.

SceneBackgroundDto.description: Canvas background: a colour and an optional image asset on top of it.

sortOrder.description: Position in the scene list, 0-based (keys 1–9 select the first nine).

version.description: Increments with every change of this scene.

SceneDto.description: Scene: ordered items on a fixed 1920 × 1080 canvas. Item order is the z-order (first = back).

id.description: Item id, e.g. `itm_…`; unique within the scene.

source.description: Source reference: `{deviceId}/{slot}` for device slots, `{assetId}` for media.

crop.description: Crop per side as a fraction of the source picture.

locked.description: Locked items cannot be moved in the editor.

SceneItemDto.description: Element of a scene (OBS: scene item). Geometry is in canvas pixels.

SetPreviewRequest.description: Sets or clears the preview scene.

backgroundAssetId.description: Optional image asset behind the text.

SlateDto.description: A full-screen slate on the output.

SlotState.description: State of a slot on a device as reported by the sender.

SlotTelemetryDto.description: Telemetry of one slot (camera or screen) of a device.

code.description: Slot code shown everywhere: K1… cameras, S1… screens, M1… media.

slot.description: Slot name for device slots: `camera` or `screen-1`…`screen-9`. Equals the LiveKit track name.

statusSince.description: Time of the last status change (timers in the Regie).

SourceDto.description: A source that scene items can show.

SourceStatus.description: Health of a source as shown in the Regie (lamps, washes, message strip).

SwitchProgramRequest.description: Request for a direct program switch (Studio-Modus off).

TakeRequest.description: Request for a take (Studio-Modus): the preview goes on air and the old program moves to the preview.

TallyDto.description: Tally of a device: overall and per slot.

TallyState.description: Tally of a source or device.

TechCheckDto.description: Result of the technical check on the sender (camera, network, bandwidth).

TechCheckLevel.description: Traffic light used by the technical check.

durationMs.description: Fade duration; one of 200, 300, 500, 800, 1000, 1500, 2000. Ignored (0) for a cut.

TransitionDto.description: Transition used for a program switch.

TransitionKind.description: Kind of transition between program scenes. A fade always runs to completion (no T-bar).

UpdateOutputAccessRequest.description: Sets the IP restriction of the output.

UpdateProductionRequest.description: Partial update of a production. Null fields stay unchanged.

UpdateSceneRequest.description: Partial update of scene settings. Null fields stay unchanged.
